An immediate consequence of Corollaries 7 and 13 is that the prices of anarchy and stability converge to 1 for a fixed series-parallel network, when the number of players goes to infinity. This is intuitively due to the fact that both LocOpt(A) and flow(NE(A)) have the same direction ⃗δ.
